widget.prompt: Build an array with 5 rows of 6.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 30 squares, but not as 5 rows of 6. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 30 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 30 squares. The array should stop at 5 rows of 6.

predict.prompt: Every ×5 product ends in which digits?
predict.reveal: Odd groups of 5 end in 5; even groups end in 0. The pattern checks an answer but does not name it.
